WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT driverId, points, wins
  FROM driverStandings
  WHERE points >= 1.0
), per_driver AS (
  SELECT driverId,
         AVG(points) AS avg_points,
         AVG(wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM eligible
  GROUP BY driverId
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins
  FROM per_driver
)
SELECT p.driverId,
       p.avg_points,
       p.avg_wins,
       p.avg_wins - o.mean_avg_wins AS difference
FROM per_driver AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.mean_avg_wins IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall mean is the unweighted average of each driver's average wins, including only non-NULL per-driver average wins; the per-driver averages ignore NULL values as specified.
